# Kinderbee

> Kinderbee is a Finnish-inspired, play-based international preschool in Bengaluru, India, and a zero-royalty preschool franchise partnership programme (Kinderbee Integrated Partnership System, KIPS). Operated by Finnishway Educare Private Limited.

## Franchise facts (as published on the website)
- Royalty: zero. Partners pay Rs 0 per month and keep 100% of recurring tuition fees, under the terms of the partnership agreement.
- Estimated capital investment: Rs 15 - 30 Lakhs (interior setup, safety flooring, furniture, activity kits, marketing launch).
- Space: ground-floor residential villa or commercial property of about 1,500 - 3,500 sq ft with outdoor play space.
- Curriculum: Finnish-inspired, child-centred, aligned with NEP 2020.
- Support: franchise operations manual, curriculum and lesson plans, teacher and staff training, admissions and marketing playbooks, school-management ERP, mentor.
